description: Replace torch.geqrf with a Triton batched Householder QR path specialized for n=32/176/352, minimizing launch overhead by processing one full small matrix per program where possible while returning exact compact H,tau.

Build a Triton blocked QR implementation for the dominant batch=640 n=512 cases, using column norm, reflector, and trailing-update kernels with robust FP32 Householder factors across dense, mixed, rankdef, and clustered inputs.

Create a Triton hybrid dispatcher that detects cheap special structure such as upper-triangular and small batches, emits direct compact factors for those cases, and falls back safely to torch.geqrf for numerically hard shapes.

Implement a Triton/PyTorch preclassifier for n=512 clustered trailing-column or triangular-ish inputs: cheap norm or strict-lower scans, exact padded compact shortcuts only when safe, otherwise untouched torch.geqrf.

Extend the safe hybrid QR dispatcher from n=512 to n=1024/2048 using cheap trailing-column norm or diagonal scans for rank-deficient and clustered-low-rank matrices; only confidently safe cases truncate GEQRF and pad compact factors, preserving fallback for ambiguous inputs.

Stack worker2's n=4096 upper-triangular direct compact-output path onto worker1's n=512 mixed rankdef and clustered splitting, preserving abs-amax safe classifiers and PyTorch GEQRF truncation behavior; add Triton classifier refinements only if they reduce overhead without unsafe matches.

Reduce detection overhead in the n=512 rankdef zero-tail shortcut without changing fallback behavior: use the cheapest exact tail all-zero guard, cached shape/stride checks, and hit-probability early exits, then benchmark against 114643 us without dense-case regressions.

Specialize only n=1024 batch=60 mixed/nearrank cases by partitioning matrices into dense versus safely structured subsets using cheap per-matrix abs-amax tail diagnostics, applying existing truncated GEQRF only to safe subsets while preserving dense fallback and avoiding general n=1024/2048 dispatcher changes.

Specialize only the n=32 path from the global best by profiling overhead, then try a fixed-size CUDA or Triton compact-H QR kernel that preserves torch.geqrf factors exactly; target launch and tiny-matrix traffic, keeping larger paths unchanged unless validation and benchmark are neutral.

Target only the unclaimed n=176 and n=352 dense batch=40 benchmark shapes with shape-specific compact QR alternatives or lower-overhead GEQRF dispatch; preserve global-best n=512 and n=1024 routing, avoid n=32 and larger paths, and keep only neutral-or-better validated dense timings.

Port f1fd083's n=352 batch=40 dense chunking path with four batch-10 GEQRF calls onto b3da92e's n=512/n=1024 structured routing; preserve exact shape guards, avoid broad dispatcher changes, benchmark the full active set, and keep only if n=352 improves without regressing b3da92e's wins.

Micro-tune b3da92e's n=1024 mixed/nearrank dispatch overhead: keep the winning specialization, reorder cheap predicates before reductions, reuse existing norm signals where possible, sweep rank-tail thresholds, and remove redundant reductions without adding a separate splitter path or regressing other shapes.
